text: Passatelli in lentil broth: knead stale breadcrumbs, egg, lemon zest and nutmeg into a stiff dough, press through a potato ricer (or roll pencil-thin and cut) into the simmering lentil broth, serve noodles and lentils together
Canederli on lemony lentils: stale bread soaked in beaten egg and a little water, seasoned with marjoram and pepper, rolled into dumplings, poached, served on lentils dressed with lemon and oil

Red-lentil egg noodles alla carbonara: blender-mill dry red lentils to flour, knead with egg, rest, roll and cut; toss off heat with yolk, lemon and plenty of black pepper, fried bread cubes in place of guanciale (variants: with pangrattato and chili; in lentil broth with lemon-marinated soft eggs)
Lentil-egg crepes: hot-soaked red lentils blended with egg, cumin and water into a thin batter, cooked as crepes, rolled around spiced crumbs and lemon

Lentil panisse: whisk blender-milled red-lentil flour into simmering water with turmeric, cook thick like polenta, spread 1 cm in an oiled tray, chill until set (~30 min), cut into fries and pan-fry; serve with aioli whisked from yolk, oil, lemon and garlic powder (variant: squares with lemon-chili dressing and a fried egg, Shan-tofu style)
Red lentil souffle: purée cooked red lentils with yolks, cumin and lemon zest, fold in whipped whites, bake in an oiled dish lined with crumbs
Steamed lentil sponge (dhokla logic): red-lentil batter leavened with whipped egg white and lemon juice, steamed, finished with a mustard-seed and chili oil tadka
Warm lentils with sauce gribiche on grilled bread: chop boiled eggs into a yolk-oil-lemon emulsion with mustard powder and dried tarragon
Masabacha-style warm lentil purée: red lentils blended with lemon and oil into a hummus plate, spiced lemon sauce, boiled egg, fried bread wedges to scoop
Skordalia-style bread-lemon sauce under crisp-fried lentils and a jammy egg: stale bread soaked and blended with oil, lemon and garlic powder
Oil-confit egg yolks over lemony smashed lentils on toast: yolks poached in barely warm oil until fudgy, crispy fried lentils on top
Breadcrumb fried 'rice': pulse stale bread to rice-sized bits, stir-fry with scrambled egg, cumin, chili and cooked lentils, lemon to finish
Breadcrumb pide: stale crumbs bound with egg pressed into a boat-shaped crust, filled with spiced lentils, an egg cracked in the middle, baked
Hand-rolled bread 'fregola' pilaf: rub breadcrumbs with egg into small pellets, toast them in oil, then cook pilaf-style with lentils and spices
Lentil gnocchi: mash lentils with breadcrumb and egg into a dough, boil the pieces, then pan-fry them in oil with dried sage and lemon zest
Cold bread emulsion soup (ajo blanco logic): stale bread, oil, lemon, garlic powder and water blended smooth and chilled, topped with lentils and chopped egg
Lentil scotch eggs: soft-boiled eggs wrapped in spiced lentil mash, crumbed and fried
Mercimek kofte with breadcrumbs in place of bulgur: shaped unfried, served with lemon
Lentil loaf: bound with egg and crumbs, baked and sliced, served with lemon
Savory French toast with lentil ragout
Lentil Monte Cristo: spiced lentil mash between bread slices, dipped in egg, fried
Lentil kuku (Persian herb frittata) with dried herbs
Lentil carbonara: whole lentils glazed with yolk-lemon-pepper, crouton 'guanciale'
Lemon egg-drop lentil soup
Lentil congee with fried-bread 'youtiao' and a soft egg
Bunny chow: lentil curry in a hollowed stale loaf, egg on top
Lentils with quick-preserved lemon and a soft egg
Egg bhurji scrambled with lentils, toast on the side
Lentil gratin under a lemon-zest crumb crust
Charred-lemon lentil bread salad with jammy eggs
Pancotto: stale bread simmered into lentil broth until porridge, egg stirred in
Zuppa pavese: egg cracked onto toasted bread, hot lentil broth ladled over
Eggs baked in a lentil-and-bread gratin dish
Lemon bread pudding
Spiced lentil crackers
Fermented lentil dosa with egg
Sprouted lentil salad with egg and lemon
Plain boiled lentils on toast with lemon
Lentil shakshuka with tomatoes and onion
